classes.name: results
classes.reason: probe.write_staged does os.write followed by os.fsync before returning, so the writing rank stalls on durability of its own per-rank file (path includes r%d and g%d_t%d), while other ranks are meanwhile writing their own files and only meet at the per-generation barrier.wait(), not per access.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: probe.write_buffered opens, writes and closes with no fsync and its timing is never recorded, so the 4 KiB payload drains from page cache behind the rank's ongoing task loop, and each rank touches only its own r%d/g%d_t%d file once.
